The most prominent feature in the foreground is the long, horizontal space bar at the bottom center of the keyboard. The keys are round with white lettering, typical of older typewriter models. The lighting creates strong highlights on the metallic and plastic surfaces.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is noticeable depth-of-field blur and potential motion blur or low-resolution softness in the upper parts of the typewriter (carriage return lever, platen), which is common in older photographs but could also indicate AI generation smoothing.

The white lettering on the round keys is somewhat indistinct and lacks sharp edges. While this could be due to image resolution, some characters appear slightly malformed or fused with the key surface, a common AI artifact in text rendering.

The alignment of the key rows shows slight irregularities. The curved rows of a typewriter keyboard should follow a precise arc; here, some keys seem slightly misaligned or unevenly spaced, though this is subtle.
